author: Ma J, Peng X, Zhang M, Gao W, Yang X, Wang Z, Chai X, Zhang Z, Wang S, Cao P
content_chunks: Opioid-induced constipation is one of the most common and persistent side effect of opioid analgesics, yet the underlying neural mechanism(s) remain unclear.
